title: The Pura Vida Web3 Ecosystem, 2025
metaDescription: Overview of Costa Rica's Web3 ecosystem – regulation, talent, clean energy, and key players shaping the future of Ethereum & blockchain in Costa Rica.

tldr.heading: TL;DR
items: National rail for Web3: Nationwide instant payments via SINPE Móvil are mainstream (≈76% of adults). The Central Bank-backed Financial Innovation Center (CIF) gives fintechs a compliant path to integrate crypto.

Pragmatic rules: Crypto is permitted by private agreement (not legal tender). In 2025, congress advanced asset registration, the state-owned National Bank launched a Bitcoin ETF feeder, and the electoral authority (TSE) approved controlled crypto donations.
Clean energy advantage: Over 99% renewable power supply (2024) enables greener mining, infrastructure, and data ops.

Soft landing for capital and talent: PROCOMER and CINDE are globally recognized FDI enablers; Digital Nomad Law attracts global builders with tax and residency perks; top English proficiency in Central America.
Adoption & talent pipeline: Circular economy payments in the Bitcoin Jungle corridor; growing developer density through ETH Pura Vida hackathons and TicoBlockchain forums.

macro.heading: Macro & Local Roots: Pura Vida Web3 Talent Hub
macro.intro: Costa Rica is Web3-ready: high internet use, near-universal mobile, and a ubiquitous instant payments rail (SINPE Móvil) that already trains users on wallet-like habits. A pragmatic, non-prohibition stance from the Central Bank keeps the door open while rules mature.
items: Instant payments: SINPE Móvil active users reached ≈76% of adults by 2024.
Clean energy narrative: Small hydro plants have hosted mining since 2021–22, linking crypto with surplus renewables.
Open, service-driven economy: PROCOMER positions Costa Rica as a digital services hub helpful for global Web3 teams.
Tourism + expats: $5B tourism industry intersects with crypto; tourists and digital nomads pay in BTC/ETH in surf towns and eco destinations.
Regional bridge: ≈5M population, stable democracy, high HDI, and bilingual talent make it a credible LATAM node for Ethereum.

timeline.heading: From pandemic era to hands-on builders
items: 2020: ETH CR launched by Jaf (EF) and Otto (PrivadoID); inaugural gathering featured Santiago Siri (Democracy Earth, Proof of Humanity), setting an early civic tech and public goods tone.
2022: Crypto Cantines began weekly meetups shifting focus to builders (tooling, L2s, infra).
Sept 2022: ETH CR founders and Andy Guzman (EF) hosted a Merge celebration aligned with the global Ethereum Merge.
2023: Ethereum Costa Rica Day at Texas Tech University; speakers from Nethermind, EF, Venus Protocol, ETH Latam.
2024: ETH Pura Vida expanded into a week of hackathons, university activations, L2 sessions, culminating in a 200+ person conference.

policy.heading: Policy & Regulatory Landscape
policy.intro: Costa Rica's regulatory approach is neutral and permissive, with growing clarity:
items: Legal status: Crypto is not legal tender, but ownership and use are allowed under Central Bank (BCCR) guidance.
Tax: Classified as virtual/intangible assets (2023); returns taxed under existing capital gains and income rules.
Regulators:
milestones: BN Fondos (2025): Bitcoin ETF — first bank-distributed crypto investment vehicle.
2025 reforms: Defined "virtual assets" and required exchanges, brokers, and custodial wallets to register with SUGEF and follow KYC/AML, aligning with FATF.

payments.heading: Payments & Merchant Rails
items: CoinPay: exchange, cards, remittance & merchant tools.
Tilopay: multi-rail checkout with e-commerce plugins.
Nimiq (OASIS & Pay): non-custodial payments; building a SINPE bridge for CRC/EUR swaps.
Bitcoin Jungle (wallet + merchant map): live circular-economy pilot on Costa Rica's Pacific South.

liquidity.heading: Liquidity, Trading & On/Off-Ramps
items: Xypher: alerts/market monitoring (CR-founded).
CoinPay: also provides exchange/liquidity desks.

infrastructure.heading: Infrastructure, Dev Tooling & Validators
items: Edenia: Web3 & AI infra/dev; validator.
WorldSibu: OSS tooling for enterprise chains (Hyperledger Labs Convector).

refi.heading: ReFi, Real-world Assets & Agri supply
items: CoFi Blocks: coffee co-op on Starknet; NFTs & on-chain commerce.

creator.heading: Creator Economy, Ticketing & Fan Tech
items: Enigma.art: entertainment tech stack (tickets, wallet, marketplace).
Hallos: NFT ticketing platform (CR-founded).

wallets.heading: Wallets, Currencies & Stable value experiments
items: Divi Project/Wallet: PoS chain & wallet brand with CR footprint.
VICU: CR-launched USD-pegged stablecoin pilot.

community.heading: Community & Talent Pipeline
community.intro: Costa Rica's Web3 scene blends education, onboarding, and flagship events, accelerating adoption and giving builders repeatable paths from meetup to shipped product.
items: Ethereum Costa Rica: country hub for Ethereum education and builder activation; runs ETH Pura Vida (national conference) and created the Ethereum Developer Pack with CENFOTEC.

AsoBlockchain: national non-profit convening industry, academia, and builders; co-hosts TicoBlockchain with AsoFintech; meets via CriptoCantina; hosted Hacker House Costa Rica (2025) for Celestia's Mammothon.
AsoFinTech: fintech association aligning Web3 with payments, compliance, and bank rails.
CriptoCiudad: "Cryptocity" initiative mapping and onboarding crypto-accepting merchants (San José map and more).
ReFi CostaRica: local node in the global ReFi movement; climate/impact use cases.
Bitcoin Jungle: community-run, open payments lab in the Pacific South (Dominical/Uvita) with wallet, merchant network, and visitor guide.

academia.heading: Academia & Institutional Engagement
academia.intro: Web3 is growing in a very real and Pura Vida way: universities add programs, coding groups become communities, banks enter digital assets, and government starts to engage.
items: CENFOTEC: partners with ETH CR and ETH Kipu on the "Ethereum Developer Pack" teaching Solidity and dApp development.
Tecnológico de Costa Rica (TEC): leads Project Rise, tokenizing real estate (potentially on Ethereum) to revitalize urban areas like San José's Historic Center.
Dojo Coding: Starknet-focused builder community; learn-by-doing, soft skills, and growth.
Banco Nacional (BN Fondos): Bitcoin ETF for regulated exposure.
Supreme Electoral Tribunal (TSE): approved crypto donations for political parties for 2026 under transparency and auditing.

acceleration.heading: Acceleration, Investment & Capital Flows
acceleration.intro: Costa Rica's capital stack blends a regulated retail on-ramp, active accelerators/VC, and strong investment promotion.
onRampsItems: BN Fondos enables compliant crypto investment and clear retail entry points.
acceleratorsItems: Carícaco: impact catalyst and venture platform.
Carao Ventures: early-stage VC for Central America.
Newtopia VC: pre-seed and seed across LATAM.
500 Global LatAm: LATAM program; Costa Rican startups admitted in Batch 15.
Startup Costa Rica: scouting and soft-landing for venture funding and US go-to-market.
promotionItems: PROCOMER: trade & investment promoter with FDI services and FTZ guidance.
CINDE: private, non-profit investment promotion agency with a recognized FDI track record.

events.heading: Main Events & Momentum
events.intro: Education programs and spaces keep growing, with meetups, talks, and workshops across the country.
items: Blockchain Jungle 2023: 3,000+ attendees at the National Convention Center; sustainability and real-world cases.
ETH Pura Vida Hackathon 2024: first large Web3 hackathon; winners delivered an Ethereum microloan system and an agricultural traceability tool.
Dojo Coding "Starknet Hackathon" 2025: 300+ builders, $32K in prizes, direct paths to funding; stronger dev density and L2 fluency.
TicoBlockChain: 300+ professionals from fintech/crypto/Web3; topics included regulation, tokenization, and AI; local teams pitched to investors.
upcomingItems: ETH Pura Vida 2025 (Nov): talks, workshops, and full-stack hacking at a leading engineering campus.
Blockchain Jungle 2025: target 6,000+ participants and 150+ speakers across AI, blockchain, and future-tech.

roadAhead.heading: Road Ahead
items: Costa Rica can be the preferred testbed for Web3 pilots due to size and adoption; friendly regulation and ≈75% payment adoption make it attractive for building, incubating, and shipping to LATAM.
Green and credible: existing hydropowered mining capacity and a national sustainability brand make a natural home for ReFi, tokenized conservation, low-carbon validators, and ESG-oriented capital.
Coffee, agriculture, and experience-based tourism can be wrapped as RWAs on Ethereum (pre-financing, loyalty), creating exemplary practical cases from global demand to local producers.

Multinationals already trust Costa Rica for shared services; growing institutional participation (banks, regulators) lowers perceived jurisdictional risk, positioning Costa Rica as the compliance-grade nearshore for global firms' Web3 adoption.
